name: Gift of the Darkwood
body:
Your flesh hardens akin to that of darkwood.

Prerequisites: Plant Type, 5 HD, Photosynthetic Healing

Benefit: Your hardened flesh grants you DR 3/adamantine. In addition, you are immune to non-lethal damage.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
